title: Template:6SEBracket/doc
wikitext:
{{6SEBracket}}

==Use==
Format usually used in tournaments with a group stage with two groups. After the Round Robin, the 2nd and 3rd ranked teams or players face one-another (cross-group), after which the winner advances to play against a 1st ranked team or player. The winners of those meet in the Grand Finals
*R1 starts with 4 seeds (R1D1-4) who play. 
*R2W1 and R2W2 are the advancing players, they are now up against the higher seeds who drop down into the bracket (R2D1 and R2D2).
*The winners play each other in the finals (R3W1 vs R3W2)
* If a map went to overtime, use <mark>|mapXot=</mark>. The value equals the number of consecutive OT's on this map.
* Walkover: set race to wo, i.e <mark>|R1D3race=wo</mark>. Can also be set to red, green, blue, yellow and white - please avoid this if you can.
